run_getClosestPoints: run the pybullet example that finds closest points between a sphere and a rotating box
create_collision_shape: create a collision shape using pybullet GEOM_SPHERE or GEOM_BOX primitives
create_multibody: create a multi-body object with a collision shape at a given position and orientation
get_closest_points: get the closest points between two collision shapes or bodies within a distance threshold
add_debug_line: add a debug line between two 3D points to visualize closest point distances
